selection: all deterministic non-quarantined return Closure evidence, clause, file-authority and financial-projection candidates

lock.transactionBoundary: one repeatable-read transaction per deterministic batch; earlier batches remain committed if a later batch fails

cancellation: cancel before each batch commit; interruption after apply begins is outcome-unknown and requires same-operation reconcile
idempotency: source keys, clause keys, file hash CAS and Closure version plus financial-authority fingerprints prevent duplicate or stale DML
checksums: classification digest binds exact Closure, order, return evidence, clause, file, expected version and bill/disposition authority facts
exitCondition: retire after historical return Closure facts no longer require Stage1 backfill
